name: ScrapeGraphAI
summary: AI-powered scrape, extract, search and crawl with natural-language prompts (ScrapeGraphAI v2 API).

api_key.description: a ScrapeGraphAI API key, starting sgai- (scrapegraphai.com/dashboard)

notes: Auth is the SGAI-APIKEY header. All paths are under /api. This is the v2 API; the v1 host and its smartscraper/searchscraper/markdownify/smartcrawler endpoints are deprecated.
An optional SGAI-Session-Id header groups related requests for the history list.
Crawls are asynchronous: start, poll status, then page through crawl.pages.
Monitors (scheduled change detection) are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Scrape a URL
endpoints.summary: Fetch a page in one or more formats: markdown, HTML, links, images, summary, JSON extraction, branding or screenshot.

url.description: Public URL to fetch; private addresses are rejected.

formats.description: Output formats, each {"type": ...}: markdown, html, links, images, summary, json (with prompt and schema), branding or screenshot.

allowedTypes.description: MIME allowlist; omit to allow all supported types.

processors.description: e.g. [{"type": "pdf", "maxPages": 10}]; PDFs are capped at 25 pages by default and cost 1 credit per page.

fetchConfig.description: Fetch options: mode (auto, fast, js), stealth, headers, cookies, scrolls, wait, timeout (ms), country.

notes: A read over POST: it fetches a page and changes nothing in your account.
Credits are per format; stealth adds 5.

endpoints.name: Extract structured data with a prompt
endpoints.summary: Natural-language structured extraction from a URL, HTML or markdown.

prompt.example: What is the title of this page?

url.description: Page to extract from; send exactly one of url, html or markdown.

schema.description: JSON Schema the output must match.

fetchConfig.description: Fetch options: mode (auto, fast, js), stealth, headers, cookies, scrolls, wait, timeout (ms), country.

notes: A read over POST: it extracts data and changes nothing in your account.

endpoints.name: Search and fetch the top results
endpoints.summary: Web search with page content returned inline and optional AI extraction across results.

numResults.description: Results to return and fetch, 1-20; default 3.

prompt.description: Run AI extraction across the results; adds a json field to the response.

schema.description: JSON Schema for the extraction; requires prompt.

fetchConfig.description: Fetch options: mode (auto, fast, js), stealth, headers, cookies, scrolls, wait, timeout (ms), country.

notes: A read over POST: it runs a search and changes nothing in your account.
Costs 2 credits per result, or 5 with a prompt.

endpoints.name: Start a crawl
endpoints.summary: Start an asynchronous multi-page crawl and get a job id.

formats.description: Output formats, each {"type": ...}: markdown, html, links, images, summary, json (with prompt and schema), branding or screenshot.

maxLinksPerPage.description: Cap on links expanded per page.

includePatterns.description: Glob URL patterns to include, e.g. ["/blog/*"].

fetchConfig.description: Fetch options: mode (auto, fast, js), stealth, headers, cookies, scrolls, wait, timeout (ms), country.

notes: A read over POST: it starts a job that only produces data.
Async: poll crawl.status, then read content with crawl.pages. Costs 2 credits to start plus per-page scrape cost.

endpoints.name: Get a crawl's status
endpoints.summary: Progress and lightweight page metadata of a crawl job.

id.description: Crawl job id returned by crawl.start.

notes: Status is running, completed, failed or stopped.

endpoints.name: Get a crawl's pages
endpoints.summary: Cursor-paginated pages of a crawl with their scrape results.

id.description: Crawl job id returned by crawl.start.

cursor.description: Zero-based index to start at; use pagination.nextCursor from the last response.

endpoints.name: Stop a crawl
endpoints.summary: Stop an in-flight crawl; fetched pages stay available.

id.description: Crawl job id returned by crawl.start.

endpoints.name: Resume a crawl
endpoints.summary: Resume a stopped crawl from its last frontier.

id.description: Crawl job id returned by crawl.start.

endpoints.name: Delete a crawl
endpoints.summary: Permanently remove a crawl record and its stored pages.

id.description: Crawl job id returned by crawl.start.

endpoints.name: List past requests
endpoints.summary: Recent API calls on your account, newest first.

sessionId.description: Case-insensitive partial match on session id.

endpoints.name: Get credits, plan and job quotas
endpoints.summary: Remaining credits, plan name and crawl/monitor quotas; free and a quick key check.
